text:
rachel: Heads up 14 noticed steady 'splinter' evictions across azs when jobs request nvlink and we try to pack by GPU-count only.
dmitri: saw that too. tiny-gang jobs asking for 4 GPUs with `requireNVLink=true` get placed, then larger non-nvlink jobs force packing reshuffles and we evict the tiny-gang mid-run.
oliver: sample event: 
```
Preempt: pod=tiny-gang-97 node=eu-west1b-rack7-slot3 reason=placement.repack:nvlink_mismatch
meta: requested_nvlink=true node_nvlink=false packed_after: 22s reschedule_delay=8s
```
priya: why are we ignoring nvlink when scoring? thought we had a feature gate to prefer nvlink-capable nodes for nvlink=true.
rachel: scheduler uses featureScore but weight is low, and the binpacker tries to minimize waste so it still lands on non-nvlink to fill gaps. then when a large NVLink-agnostic gang comes, the rebalancer prefers consolidating high-throughput racks and evicts the tiny-gang.
dmitri: cost/regret: we replayed ~2.4 GPU-days last 48h in eu-west region because of this churn. small-team flagged increased tail latency too.
oliver: immediate mitigations: 1) bump nvlink affinity weight for pods with requireNVLink, 2) mark non-nvlink thin-shelves as low-priority for nvlink=true, 3) add avoidRepackForSeconds=60 for recently started tiny-gangs.
priya: also add metric `placement.splinter.count` and `placement.repack_reason` tag. we need cross-az breakdown.
alerts-bot: autoscaler: scaled +4 nodes eu-west1 across racks at 2026-03-23T14:12Z (event id: 9c2e).
rachel: config sketch: 
```
apiVersion: scheduler.redwood/v1
kind: PlacementTuning
metadata:
  name: nvlink-protections
spec:
  nvlinkAffinityWeight: 50
  avoidThinShelvesForNVLink: true
  avoidRepackWindowSeconds: 60
  repackCostThresholdGPUSeconds: 300
```
dmitri: test plan: run perf job fleet that requests requireNVLink=true at low arrival rate and then inject high-memory non-nvlink jobs to force repack; measure `placement.splinter.count` and `gpu.wasted_seconds`.
oliver: rollout: canary scheduler change to 5% in eu-west1 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. monitor `placement.splinter.count`, `reschedule_delay_p95`, and `gpu.effective_runtime`. rollback if splinters > baseline +8%.
priya: telemetry: I'll add tags to the `scheduler.events` stream and dashboard: repack_reason=nvlink_mismatch, node_nvlink=true/false, pod_nvlink=true/false.
alerts-bot: noted. will attach autoscaler events and repack notices into the thread.
rachel: owners: @dmitri implement scoring & avoidRepackWindow, @priya add metrics & dashboard, @oliver run tests and coordinate canary.
dmitri: will open PR with scoring change and unit tests. also adding e2e to mimic repack flow.
oliver: grep helper: `kubectl -n kube-system logs -l app=scheduler -c scheduler | jq -r '.msg' | grep repack`
priya: alert rule suggestion: `placement.splinter.count > 2/min for 10m` -> page on-call, but suppress noisy alerts if repack_reason=maintenance.
rachel: timeline: PR today, canary 02:00 UTC, 24h soak if stable then promote. need cost delta estimate in PR.
dmitri: noted. will include estimated GPU-hour savings from reduced churn.
oliver: thanks team 14 this should help tiny-gang SLO and reduce wasted GPU-hours. :thumbsup:
